fact: UNHCR states it had registered 18,900 individuals from 64 countries in Morocco by the end of 2024, including 4,679 new registrations in the year, primarily Sudanese.

UNHCR RIMAP says Morocco's BRA commission, which regularises UNHCR-registered refugees, moved to twice-weekly sessions in 2024, reviewing about 20 individuals a week, and admitted undocumented refugees and unaccompanied children.
system: Bureau des Refugies et Apatrides (BRA) commission
